brief: Keep it under 40 seconds and upbeat. Open on the intro where I say who I am, and end on the line about sitting down to record. End card that says "Caleb Schalesky" with "AI systems for small business". Two shorts. Change: slow down the middle, drop the second clip.

notes: Change applied: dropped the second clip of the previous EDL (ED290DD7, 'I have many different systems... the most important one', 8.4s) and slowed the middle. Cuts total 22.05s plus a 3s end card = 25.05s, well under 40 even before pause trimming, so there is headroom if you want that bridge back. Shorts unchanged; both surviving clips are still in the cut.
